campaign.source: Preserved research/proposal: SOURCE-PLAN-2026-09-20.md, copied with whitespace normalized from research/codkit-universal-fork-review-2026-09-20/03-synthesis-and-plan.md. Product contracts govern implementation; the source's architectural recommendations do not silently resolve its owner decision list.

baseline.fact: Worktree was created from 03d2cee and rebased to a9a11c7; main, origin/main and github/main agree on a9a11c7. Main is clean.

Initial machine-readable public-format catalogs: 0. Initial public-format compatibility gates: 0. Candidate: 1 catalog with 55 entries, 1 gate and 10 focused tests. Of 55 entries, 11 have explicit inherited-version or missing-version gaps.
The initial P0.1 inventory atom changed no production TypeScript, runtime output, consumer serializers or history fingerprints. Later contract atoms below intentionally add opt-in format transitions.

decisions.decision: Start with the P0.1 inventory. It exposes compatibility gaps without choosing config v3, trusted registry locations or organization licence semantics. Deferring all development until those decisions would lose the independently useful discovery/gate step.

Keep runtime validators and governing contracts authoritative. Catalog metadata records current behavior; assigning invented versions or automatically rewriting consumers is rejected. Revisit when implementing the source plan's migration atoms.

Use the installed TypeScript 7 scanner for a bounded static coverage tripwire; do not execute adapters. Its removed legacy compiler API prevents the old parser path. Dynamic/computed format conventions require explicit catalog/discovery fixtures; this gate is not a proof of arbitrary program behavior.

predictions.prediction: Existing consumer serialization and generated history remain byte-identical: this atom edits tooling, metadata and the npm development gate only.
Deleting a format policy, changing a numeric schema or deleting migration/test evidence makes the focused gate red.
The complete floor is already blocked on the base; catalog changes alone cannot make it green.

route.phase: Read the source proposal, inspect schemas and probe baseline gates; no commits. Complete.

Public-contract hardening: P0.1-P0.5 and P0.9 are implemented candidates. P0.7 package/publish receipts also pass the complete native floor; the delegated technical decisions and remaining owner boundaries are recorded below. Exit: exact existing fixture compatibility and complete project floor.

Licensing and release evidence: P0.10 and the evidence portion of P0.7. Trusted-policy/source/provenance/notice/SPDX and package/publish mechanism candidates pass the full native floor. Actual commercial policy rulings are not supplied by fixtures.
Local workspace lifecycle: P0.11; workspace pairs, unique refs and writer refusal.
Trusted external type supply: P0.3/P0.4 with a real partner; offline install, integrity and pre-import handshake proof.
Measured expansion with real consumers: codec seam P0.6, coordinator contract P0.8, build recipe design P0.12; new implementation follows its polygon.

current-atom.perimeter: Owner supplied another real historical Theia consumer; its reconstructed source patchset is checked on isolated roots. Prove materialization/extraction/local component delivery, then actual Linux build using verified dependencies. Retain independent supplier, commercial/legal/signing and reconstruction boundaries.
current-atom.acceptance: Inspect actual consumer state and exercised public seams before defining extensions. Codec and coordinator boundaries must have executable examples and preserve existing wire bytes. Build recipe v2 follows real measured requirements, with complete available gates and explicit external supply/legal/signing boundaries.
current-atom.negative-proof: No fixture becomes real partner or consumer acceptance; no silent format widening, migration, signing custody or legal approval.
current-atom.safe-stop: Final Phase 5 contract snapshot d284130: complete Linux 2882 passes/four existing skips; all available native gates green, eight frozen/zero new findings. AUDIT.md retains CK-A67–CK-A72. Actual external partner and commercial/signing/namespace evidence remain outside fixture mechanism proof.

review-points.open: The owner delegated unattended development on 2026-10-03. The source decision inventory is the eight numbered items in the source plan's “Решения владельца перед кодированием”: Git boundary, discipline axis, schema migration, component/coordinator split, registry/policy trust, runtime inclusion, commercial notice ruling, signing and type namespace ownership. Inventory work does not ratify them.

See PHASE5-THEIA-CONSUMER-2026-10-04.xml and consumer recovery/feature-proof/package-ui. Kernel PIDs match durable writer records, release is awaited, and the next task can acquire after exit. Exact Windows lock/writer/process suite passes 29/29 plus typecheck and focused format check. An initial broader Windows run passed 19/21 lock cases, with two fixtures failing EPERM before product code while creating privileged directory symlinks; those Windows fixtures now use real NTFS junctions with unchanged outside sentinel/refusal assertions, not skipped tests. Linux retains directory symlinks. Offline non-root Linux snapshot before that Windows-only fixture refinement passes the same 29 tests and all format/catalog/receipt/typecheck/runtime/trace/docs/supply/native gates, eight frozen/zero new findings and 1515 spec units. This is scoped new evidence, not another full-suite pass or native macOS/full Windows lifecycle/NFS/SMB acceptance. Existing CK-A68/CK-A70 risks remain open. Actual external supplier and owner policy/custody evidence are still required.

Integration exposed independent PS-clean/init/commit/resolve/terminal dirt readers that assumed .codkit was ignored. Fork provisional apply permits only the exact validated role receipt; ordinary fork dirt is unchanged. PS current branches may enter their own UUID cycle namespace, while creation retries remain on the initial task branch. Added parameters initially crossed three 600-line budgets; init inspection, commit status and workspace resolve status/Git facts were extracted along responsibility seams instead of broadening baseline. Full offline non-root Linux Vitest suite before the last helper move: 230 files/2862 tests passed, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped; conform was then red for the resolve budget. P0.11 declared build-output archives 1fbd007: explicit material v4 adds type-declared untracked/ignored output candidates from layout cleanup/package/per-owned-root build patterns, excluding Git-tracked and runtime .codkit state and already saved materials. Regular bytes or literal leaf-link text are retained immutably outside the pair with SHA-256/size/mode, config and type declaration digests; snapshots are rechecked after archival. Exact empty output directories grant no contents cleanup authority. Removal compares backing/current snapshots at each barrier, never follows links and preserves external linked directories. Unknown neighbours, changed contents/kinds/modes, missing archives, special files and new kinds in strict v1/v2/v3 refuse. Initial new cases correctly failed drift because preserved outputs were not yet included among exact certified untracked paths; finish now certifies only already captured material paths, retaining normal tracked/other-file guards. Three additional real-Git cases prove retained bytes after deletion, empty directories, missing/changed backing refusal and external directory-link preservation. Final offline non-root Linux thirty-two-file package/ownedRoots/build/inputs/material/LFS/overlay/lifecycle/daemon/CI/cycle/CLI regression passes 403 tests with one existing platform case skipped; catalog 73/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 291-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor green with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1504 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. P0.11 daemon failure custody d002778: startup tracks ownership of the post-rotation log generation. No-child failures and proven empty POSIX groups may archive only their new generation and retire exact reservations. A thrown termination, live group or unproven Windows descendant teardown preserves/CAS-publishes the spawned PID where reservation custody remains; no false rollback or cleanup authorization is reported. Legacy unselected behavior remains unchanged. Missing-log proven dead generations retire without invented archive evidence. After channel release, only exact contained empty .codkit/build is pruned with nonrecursive rmdir; nonempty or unavailable directories remain. Four additional deterministic real-Git cases prove no-child cleanup through finish/remove, failed owned log archive with neighbouring human data preserved, actual PID retention on termination failure and missing-log POSIX retirement. Final rebuilt offline non-root Linux complete suite passes 230 files and 2856 tests, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped; catalog 73/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 290-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor green with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1503 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. Windows uncertainty still fails closed and requires the already documented native descendant proof where the root disappears.

Closure receipts bind UUID/nonce/channel/patchset/tree ID/path/digest/size; current/rotated log copies must match preserved backing bytes, and removal rechecks them at each barrier. Missing/changed archives, edited or unowned logs and malformed/future/foreign receipts refuse. Privileged registry context propagates through CLI/CI/cycle probes; warning/tree call-site guards remain mandatory. Three real-Git archive cases prove unchanged rotation, post-removal byte retention, changed/unowned content and corrupt/future archive refusal; the real watcher launcher scenario now completes down/finish/remove without losing logs. Final offline non-root Linux thirty-file build/inputs/material/LFS/overlay/lifecycle/daemon/CI/cycle/CLI/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 371 tests with one existing platform case skipped. Catalog 73/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 290-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor pass with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1502 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped evidence, not final Phase 3 acceptance or a new whole-suite proof. Build-output ownership, startup-failure/missing-log cleanup edge cases, named cycle/publish and the final full gate/audit remain open.

P0.11 witnessed inputs 2f0054c: actual workspace delivery writes strict external codkitWorkspaceInputDelivery:1 binding workspace/tree path and complete existing input snapshot. Receipt keys include the full canonical mapping so distinct rebuilt outputs remain distinct immutable witnesses. P0.11 material receipt v2 fa2f6f2: strict v1 remains unchanged, while explicit v2 admits hydrated LFS and exact anchored empty-directory entries. Saved LFS pointers/committed attributes are resolved in the existing isolated attribute oracle with no local info/attributes or machine authority; current payload hash/size and backing bytes in the source common repository LFS store must agree. The private oracle directory is canonically verified before cleanup. Empty directories require a saved own placeholder/manifest anchor and must still be empty at deletion; extra data refuses, and no whole prefix is authorized. Only captures requiring new kinds emit v2; future formats and new kinds in v1 refuse. Actual fixture LFS filters demonstrate that Git status can recreate an absent backing object while source checkout data remains, so the negative proof now removes the patchset worktree first, then loses the backing object and verifies the remaining fork is preserved until restoration/retry. Local info/attributes without committed LFS authority refuses. Final exact offline non-root Linux twenty-six-file LFS export/material/overlay/lifecycle/daemon/CI/cycle/CLI/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 320/320; catalog 71/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 288-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor pass with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1500 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped proof, not a complete-suite rerun or Phase 3 acceptance. The backing check uses the standard common-repository LFS store, consistent with the existing export mechanism. Inputs, build outputs, retained logs, named cycle/publish and final complete gate/audit remain open.

P0.11 saved material cleanup d6eb1f4: strict external codkitWorkspaceMaterials:1 binds workspace ID and exact existing finish proof without widening registry/checkout/config schemas. Declared own-source/extension copies must match regular blobs of the sealed patchset commit. The local dev-channel sidecar must equal the shared read-only overlay renderer, with config/overlay inputs matching saved blobs; retained text/digests authorize no arbitrary neighbouring paths. Malformed/future/traversal receipts, source-map forgery, changed targets, ignored unsaved own work and unowned neighbours refuse. Initial regressions exposed the tool's empty .codkit/tmp and local manifest.overrides.json as unowned; workspace execution now prunes only its empty scratch directory and shares the dev-channel renderer rather than inferring ownership by filename. Legacy scratch behavior stays unchanged. Final offline non-root Linux twenty-four-file material/lifecycle/start/daemon/CI/cycle/overlay/CLI/argv/JSON/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 296/296; actual launcher load/fresh/finish/remove and interrupted patchset-first removal pass. Catalog 71/11, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 287-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor pass with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1499 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped evidence; latest complete suite remains 2835 passes/four existing skips. Produced inputs, build outputs, retained daemon logs, empty declared materialization directories and LFS-backed source copies still need explicit ownership handling before Phase 3 acceptance, followed by named cycle/publish proof and the full final gate/audit.

P0.11 daemon/lifecycle serialization 64b53ea: explicit workspace starts take the same contained user registry generation lock as finish/removal before channel files, re-read active state by exact UUID, and hold the guard through reservation/spawn/final PID publication. Registry revision stays unchanged and the guard does not outlive startup. Finished/removed stale calls cannot recreate checkout roots. Unbound starts in paired checkout markers refuse instead of treating patchset data as authority. Privileged registry-root composition context is propagated through CI/snapshot config and omitted from serialization; registry warnings reach the caller. Exact UUIDs now take precedence over UUID-shaped names, while ID authorization never falls back to a name. Four deterministic real-Git barrier cases prove finish refusal before/after reservation and before PID publication, lifecycle-held refusal, stale finished/removed calls, unbound paired calls and identity/name-shadow refusal. Updated warning call-site assertions keep tree/warning binding and now include registry authority. Final offline non-root Linux eighteen-file lifecycle/daemon/CI/cycle/CLI/argv/JSON/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 204/204; catalog 70/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 286-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor pass, eight frozen/zero new findings and 1498 spec units with the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped evidence; latest complete-suite proof remains the preceding daemon snapshot's 2835 passes/four existing skips. Saved-materialization/log cleanup and named cycle/publish/final Phase 3 audit remain open.

P0.11 daemon identity 2f1d6c4: ordinary strict codkitBuildDaemon:1 remains byte-compatible without a workspace field; explicit workspace context writes version 2 with required UUID plus existing tree ID/path and nonce. Unknown/missing/foreign-format identity refuses without migration. CI/cycle composition explicitly propagates context; lifecycle daemon checks reject foreign/unbound records. Windows four new unit cases pass. A real launcher scenario starts a watcher in one pair, copies its packet into another and proves unknown/no foreign teardown while the first watcher remains living; its owner stops it in finally. This proves explicit identity binding, not full daemon/lifecycle coordination: starts still need to serialize with finish/removal, saved-materialization/log cleanup and named cycle/publish acceptance remain open.

P0.11 named execution 8166980: --workspace selects an active name/UUID from user registry authority, verifies both real checkouts/receipts/canonical paths, bypasses ambient root settings/env and rejects explicit external root flags. Where reports the selected identity in its existing schema-2 data; the selecting CLI flag remains the source of both roots. Runtime-only configuration context derives applied/cycle/release UUID prefixes and preserves declaration prefixes separately; serialization strips context/restores declarations. Publisher immutable snapshots, CI comparison snapshots and cycle reloads explicitly inherit context. Fork drift exempts only the exact validated role receipt in the matching original checkout; finish additionally certifies only exact held lock-generation paths. Neighbouring human files remain dirty and fresh cleanup preserves the receipt. Disposable trees get no original receipt exemption. Real launcher proves named where, initial/repeated/fresh load into UUID refs, unchanged source/pair config, neighbouring work refusal and finish after applied delta; pure snapshot/serialization cases reject runtime context in persisted config. Final offline non-root Linux full suite: 226 files passed, 2830 tests passed, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped. Catalog 70/11, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 286-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor pass with eight frozen/zero new findings, 1496 spec units and the existing zero-code extraction warning. Phase 3 is still open: daemon workspace custody, safe removal of saved untracked materializations, named cycle/publish-specific proof and final integration/audit remain. Ordinary Git-tracked/receipt cleanup proof must not be mistaken for materialization cleanup acceptance.

P0.11 CLI 5edecdc: workspace create/list/show/finish/remove call the lifecycle libraries through the shipped launcher. Create requires explicit owner/session and an existing pair directory, optionally selects an immutable source ref, and refuses registry authority inside source repositories/Git administration. Registry inspection also refuses authority overlapping recorded checkout/repository/admin roots. Management takes no ambient external roots/settings and rejects explicit root flags; inspection imports no adapter. Before finish, actual patchset custody and the saved installed type declaration digest/contract are verified before adapter import/configuration. Missing registry inspection is inert and returns an empty versioned registry; absent arguments and unknown authority flags refuse. README and generated command reference describe actual commands. Exact offline non-root Linux ten-file launcher/argv/where/types/JSON/creation/finish/removal/writer/contained-I/O/linked-worktree regression passes 97/97; catalog 70/11, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 283-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor pass, eight frozen/zero new structural findings. This is scoped CLI evidence; the latest full suite remains the preceding lifecycle snapshot's 2821 passes/four existing skips. Named launcher selection, operational UUID refs and daemon ownership remain pending; Phase 3 is not accepted.

P0.11 lifecycle backend bc445fc: finish preserves immutable heads and clean/save proof while holding both checkout writer capabilities; dirty/unextracted history, stale generated evidence, foreign receipts and live/unresolved daemons refuse. Removal requires that finish proof and unchanged heads, rejects unowned physical paths including ignored files and empty directories, and retains both heads in UUID-scoped repository refs before journaling removing. Git force removal is limited to verified tracked data and owned receipt/cache/held lock generations; submodules and unknown data refuse. Checkout writer guards remain held through deletion. Interrupted deletion resumes only with absent Git registration and matching retained refs; removed repeats are inert. Eight real Git lifecycle cases prove baseline finish, dirty/foreign/live refusal, preserved ignored/empty data, changed heads, retained refs and partial-removal retries. The first verification snapshot raced native specmap generation and correctly failed trace; a rebuilt stable snapshot passed the complete offline non-root Linux suite: 224 files passed, 2821 tests passed, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped. Catalog 70 with eleven tests, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 281-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor pass; eight frozen/zero new findings, 1491 spec units with the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is backend proof, not Phase 3 acceptance: CLI, named launcher selection, operational ref namespaces and daemon ownership still remain.

Registry updates hold a contained atomic generation lock and compare raw bytes before writes. Same-owner/session retry resumes a partial first-worktree creation with unchanged receipt; moved directory custody, foreign session, changed checkout work, unsafe source/registry placement and duplicate/future identities refuse without deletion or overwrite. P0.11 writer custody 50dddd2: acquireLock now owns an exclusive physical patchset checkout guard alongside the unchanged per-tree generation. Different fork IDs, same-process independent scopes and directory aliases cannot overlap; separate checkouts remain independent. Nested cycle scopes borrow only an issued active same-checkout parent capability, guard survives all parent/child references and failed reservations unwind. Copied/released/foreign capabilities, already-live legacy owners, unknown foreign lock owners and nonregular lock files refuse. The lower-level stale-generation race/release proofs remain intact. This coordinates participating Codkit writers and detects already-live old owners; it does not control arbitrary uncooperative programs. Fixtures now forward parent capabilities; GC read-only planning still keeps live owners, while command mutation waits until checkout custody is released. Initial full run exposed these fixture forwarding/GC expectation gaps; they were corrected without permitting implicit PID-based borrowing. Final offline non-root Linux full suite: 222 files passed, 2809 tests passed, one file/four existing skips; format 68/11, receipts, typecheck, 277-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor green, eight frozen/zero new findings. Windows new writer cases pass; the existing two directory-symlink privilege cases remain EPERM and are not hidden. Named pair create/list/show/finish/remove, launcher selection/ref namespaces and workspace daemon ownership remain open; Phase 3 and the campaign are not accepted.

Phase 1/2 technical mechanism candidates are green; next P0.11 local workspace lifecycle, with actual commercial/signing/real partner/consumer evidence still external.

Every used standard license/exception now requires trusted standardLicenseTexts; missing text refuses instead of treating an ID as an attached notice. Explicit UTC creation time and content-derived namespace are stable; file-level copyright/in-file licensing are not invented from source. Attached documents require exact expected UTF-8 bytes and unchanged payload. External string-version catalog proof freezes SPDX-2.3 without inventing a numeric Codkit version. Mechanism fixtures are not commercial approvals. Phase 2 release/config selection, source-carrier enforcement and complete-suite acceptance remain open.
